environment.description: Go Gin application deployed on an EC2 instance with an Application Load Balancer (ALB) forwarding all traffic directly. The ALB has no WAF attached. The application listens on port 8080 and the ALB target group health-checks on /health. Security groups allow inbound 80/443 from 0.0.0.0/0 to ALB and ALB to EC2:8080. No content security policy headers configured. Users access the application directly via the ALB DNS name.

config.tls: ALB terminates TLS with ACM cert
